Hi,

 I am trying to plot google visulization motion chart in a tabsetpanel, bit it is not giving me expected resutls

Here is my UI.R Code

mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id="tabSelected",
    tabPanel("Visualize",div(style="color:white",p(textOutput("caption")),htmlOutput("gvis"))),

 ) )

First tab always give me result , where as other tabs are not showing me anything
1. If i give htmlOutput("gvis") in first tab it shows me result
2. If i give htmlOutput("gvis") in second tab it show me nothing 

How can i deploy this shiny app to glimmer.r-studio.com. I dont see how to create an account and login
